thread:
Alex P: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. A few people asked about sequencing for the next sprints for API, Console, and Optimize. Capturing Qs here so we have a single source.

Maria S: Great, Alex. Quick answers off the top: API staged rollout targeted mid-May, Console v2 beta targeted late June, Optimize pilot targeted early July. I'll post exact dates later today.

Devon: mid-May for API — does that include the streaming perf improvements + function-calling throttle fixes? :thinking:

Maria S: Yes — streaming perf and the function-calling throttle fixes are in the mid-May cut. We may mark function-calling as limited-GA for smaller accounts initially; Dedicated GA will follow based on capacity.

Helen: For streaming perf we still need the kernel backport (runtime). ETA for the patch is 2026-05-07. If that slips, fallback latency will be ~10-15% higher on certain model/seq combos.

Devon: Canary thresholds we should aim for (to be explicit):
```
latency_p99: 150ms
error_rate: 0.1%
throughput_drop: <5% vs baseline
```

Alex P: @Devon yep those are the targets. Ops will manage autoscaling and the safe fallback policy during canary.

ops-bot: Deploy queued: api/streaming-kernel-backport #1342 -> staging at 2026-05-03T02:00Z

Helen: Also flag — Console v2 beta changes a bit of the UI surface and requires new RBAC scopes. Product will share a migration guide and a small compatibility shim for teams.

Maria S: Draft migration guide: https://redwood.docs/console-v2-migration (private draft). Please review comments by EOD Friday.

Samira: For Optimize pilot (target 2026-07-06) we'll onboard 3 pilot customers and need help curating eval sets and prompt suites. @DevEx can we get two engs to help with setup and evaluation harness? :pray:

DevEx: Assigned — Ali and Priya will take the pilot onboarding tasks. Sync scheduled tomorrow 11:00.

Alex P: ACTIONS: Maria to publish final dates, Helen to escalate kernel risk if the backport is blocked, Samira to share the pilot checklist and eval targets, Ops to confirm canary thresholds and autoscaling runbook. I'll schedule a 30-min follow-up next Tuesday to confirm go/no-go. :calendar:

Maria S: One more note on capacity: if Dedicated demand spikes after the API rollout, we may segment the Optimize pilot by region/customers to avoid external noise. We'll update the pilot plan if that happens.

Devon: ack. I'll add the canary checks to the test matrix.

Samira: ack and thanks — I'll post the pilot checklist in this thread once ready.

Alex P: Closing this thread for now — please add any unresolved Qs here and I'll loop in leads. :hand:
